added 8 commits
  • dd5c4ded - kerberos: make use of &NT_errors_ext
  • aafce0e3 - smb-direct: make use of &NT_errors_ext
  • ffb5f68f - idl2wrs: make use of {NT,WERR}_errors_ext
  • aee1d496 - dcerpc-{budb,butc}: regenerate after {NT,WERR}_errors_ext idl2wrs changes
  • 45d49527 - tools/pidl: make use of {NT,WERR,HRES}_errors_ext
  • 8b06d69f - svcctl.cnf: make use of WERR_errors_ext
  • f22c4676 - pidl:dcerpc-*: regenerate dissectors after {NT,WERR,HRES}_errors_ext pidl changes
  • 7a0c998f - windows-common: don't export legacy {NT,WERR,HRES}_errors
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16448/diffs?diff_id=1066585415&start_sha=527b19a62758021b930cce7b6a5a05bf1c4b3cac)

This needs to be `BASE_DEC|BASE_EXT_STRING`, and similar for all the `hf` definitions, when switching to an extended value string. That's what's causing the tests to fail (there ends up being a cast to the wrong type of struct.)

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16448/diffs?diff_id=1068331348&start_sha=7a0c998fa27e9cc0679dc6fdb3ed590aa9dbc846#73eb1e46907eac0b8b260581f21009bc5ff04e3e_1147_1149)
This needs to be `BASE_HEX|BASE_EXT_STRING` when switching to a `value_string_ext`.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16448/diffs?diff_id=1068331348&start_sha=7a0c998fa27e9cc0679dc6fdb3ed590aa9dbc846#e40ff65a5b612ae8c07c1721ae98ff5b6705d6c9_895_895)
